customMethods.name: exportOrderStates
customMethods.script:
''' 
 		Exports performance information and associated data such as class and link info
 		 
 		Args: 
 			itemIds (list[int]): list of itemIds
 		Returns: 
 			exportInfo (dict) 
 			message (string): None if successful 
 		Updated: 
 			jz  10/14/25 created
 	'''
 	dbName = system.kanoa.config.getDBName('core') 
 	log = system.util.getLogger('kanoa_lot')
 	
	import java.lang
	
	PSIds = [row['performanceStateId'] for row in self.view.custom.orderStates.selectedData]
 	log.info("exportorderStates() called with %s"%(PSIds)) 
 	exportInfo = {}
 	
 	try:
		orderStates = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.performanceState.getorderStates({'performanceStateIdList': PSIds}))
		performanceStateClassIds = list(set([row['performanceStateClassId'] for row in orderStates]))
		performanceStateClasses = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.performanceState.getPerformanceStateClasses({'performanceStateClassIdList': performanceStateClassIds}))
		PSCDict = {}
		for PSC in performanceStateClasses:
			PSCDict[PSC['performanceStateClassId']] = PSC['performanceStateClassDescription']
		for item in orderStates:
			item['performanceStateClassDescription'] = PSCDict[item['performanceStateClassId']]
		performanceStateLinks = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.performanceState.getPerformanceStateLinks({'performanceStateIdList': PSIds}))
		
 		exportInfo['orderStates'] = orderStates
		exportInfo['performanceStateLinks'] = performanceStateLinks
	 	
 		data = system.util.jsonDecode(str(system.util.jsonEncode(exportInfo)))
 		fileName = 'Performance States Export ({}).json'.format(system.date.format(system.date.now(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'))
	
		document = system.util.jsonEncode({'exportType': 'performanceStateInfo', 'data': system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(data))})
		system.perspective.download(fileName, document)
		
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Performance States exported'})
 		 
 	except java.lang.Exception, e:
 		log.error("exportorderStates() threw exception %s "%(e.cause))
 		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': 'Performance States failed to export: %s'%e.cause})
	
	return
